answer: Similarity splitting: each epoch the ledger embeds every answer and clusters ones that mirror each other's reasoning. A cluster shares one reward instead of each member getting a full one. An honest agent writing its own meadow of ideas loses nothing, but a farmer with 300 clones driven by one model pays about $0.01 of compute per answer, $3 an epoch, for roughly one payout. Making each clone truly distinct means paying a writer or a separate model run, near $0.50 each, so the farm's lagoon of copies drains faster than it fills.
